messages:
Anya: Quick sync — we need to pick a ship strategy for the programmatic surface vs console admin features. Customers keep asking for console workflows but we also want low dev friction. Proposal: slice-and-ship: minimal API + SDK samples first, limited console admin beta behind flag. Thoughts?
Marcus: +1 to API-first for momentum. Console requests are real though (billing/roles). We should RICE-score to be objective.
Devin: I sketched a rough RICE this morning: Reach=medium, Impact=high for billing/roles, Confidence~0.6, Effort=4 sprints for full console. Means API-first likely wins.
Sabrina: Practical compromise — ship API endpoints for admin flows (roles, invites, billing hooks) + a read-only console page showing org metadata. That cuts console effort a lot.
Anya: Proposed launch criteria: (1) API endpoints stable and documented, (2) SDK samples in Node/Python, (3) e2e smoke passing, (4) canary <5% errors. If all pass, mark GA for hosted; console beta follows.
Marcus: Ops note: Private deployments need audit logs & KMS integration for enterprise. That is nontrivial — consider putting audit logs behind enterprise feature flag to avoid blocking hosted GA.
Devin: Agreed — feature flags work. Add runbook & rollback steps to rollout checklist. Also require perf budget: P95 <200ms for admin API paths.
Sabrina: From CS perspective, "invite team" in console is high-value but we can provide CLI + invite API for now. We'll prioritize a single compact screen for console beta (org summary + members).
Anya: I'll update the PRD with scope + RICE worksheet. Quick rollout checklist I want in the PRD:
```
- API: POST /orgs/{org_id}/roles -> minimal validation
- SDK samples: node, python (auth, invite sample)
- Console: read-only org page (beta) + members list (no full role editor)
- Feature flags: enterprise.audit_logs, console.admin_beta
- Testing: e2e, canary 10% traffic, perf tests
- Metrics: P95 latency <200ms, error rate <1%
- Security: KMS integration doc, minimal IAM scopes
```
Marcus: Ballpark effort: API surface ~2 engineers x 3 weeks, console beta ~1 designer + 1 engineer x 4 weeks. Audit logs + KMS + Private deployments add 1 sprint.
Devin: We should also include acceptance criteria for customers: sample prompts/docs + SDK snippet that a customer can use to onboard without console. Reduces support load.
Sabrina: I'll own the console MVP scope and screens. Will prioritize the members list + invite flow in the beta and defer role editing to a later slice.
Anya: Plan: I'll run the RICE doc and PRD by PM council Thurs. If approved we start API work next sprint and open a canary for a few partner accounts. @Sabrina please lead console mockups.
Sabrina: Yep — I'll post mockups by Tue.
Marcus: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: design-review scheduled for 2025-11-06 17:00 UTC (added to calendar)
Anya: Thanks all — short sync, will follow up with updated PRD link.
